intro: You are entering Lagina, Sanctuary of Hecate, in Muğla province, from the 2nd century BC. It is the only major temple to Hecate known in the ancient world, reached by a sacred way from Stratonikeia along which the yearly procession of the key was carried.
history: The temple of Hecate here is the only major sanctuary of that goddess known in the ancient world. A sacred way eleven kilometres long ran to it from Stratonikeia, and each year the procession of the key was carried along it. Look for the frieze too: it is carved with scenes from Carian history.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the temple podium and the propylon, then the sacred way and the frieze reliefs.
facts: Did you know? Hecate was the goddess of crossroads, thresholds and passages, which is why a sanctuary reached by a procession from gate to gate suits her so well. This is the only major sanctuary of Hecate known in the ancient world. And each year the procession of the key was carried along the eleven-kilometre sacred way from Stratonikeia.
outro: This brings our visit to Lagina, Sanctuary of Hecate to an end. Please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. May the goddess of crossroads guide you well on your way. Enjoy your visit.
